Title: Prepare demo dataset and corpus
Description: As a product owner, I want a curated demo corpus loaded into the vector store so that the demo finds strong evidence and the seeding output is credible. The work curates a seed corpus of patents in the demo paper's field and loads them into the vector store, ensuring the field is well-represented so evidence search finds strong prior art and seeding opportunities are relevant.
AcceptanceCriteria: Demo paper field is identified and agreed upon
Representative patents in that field are selected (50+ documents)
Patents are embedded and loaded into vector store (AI Search or Qdrant)
Evidence corpus search finds relevant prior art for demo paper
Seeding recommendations are aligned with the demo field
Vector index is deployed to prod before demo day
TalkingPoints: I'm going to prepare the demo corpus: select a research paper field, find patents in that field, then embed and load them into the vector store. This is going to ensure the demo finds strong evidence and the seeding output is credible.

Tasks.Title: Finalize demo paper field and content
Tasks.Description: Confirm demo paper domain with stakeholders; ensure it is representative and interesting.

Tasks.Title: Curate seed corpus of 50+ relevant patents
Tasks.Description: Search USPTO/EPO for patents in demo field; select diverse, high-quality patents.

Tasks.Title: Load corpus into vector store (AI Search or Qdrant)
Tasks.Description: Embed patents using model-router; upsert into vector index on prod.

Tasks.Title: Verify search finds strong evidence for demo paper
Tasks.Description: Query vector index with demo paper keywords; confirm relevant hits rank high.
